headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers 9-5.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. being placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right forearm flexor strain, and Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation, and Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with an abdominal strain. Trevor McDonald has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation, and James Outman has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion.

Roster movement saw Harold Rivas traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox, and Jacob Berry traded to the Kansas City Royals from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Endy Rodríguez contributed to the Pirates' win.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by a dominant performance from their offense. Miguel Vargas led the charge with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
